infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Allow VIMS to access your camera to scan visitor QR codes, take profile photos, and capture ID or vehicle photos.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Allow VIMS to access your photo library to upload IDs, receipts, profile pictures, and vehicle photos.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Allow VIMS to save or share generated visitor QR codes and exported documents.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Allow VIMS to access your microphone only when camera capture requires it.

plugins.cameraPermission: Allow VIMS to access your camera to scan QR codes.
